It’s a sensation: A real t-rex has just hatched from an egg – in YOUR dino zoo game! Create a fantastic animal world teeming with prehistoric creatures and wow your visitors. In this dino game, you’re the proud owner of a dino zoo with numerous attractions. 
These are some of the challenges you’ll face in this dino simulation:

•	Provide and decorate enclosures for your dinosaurs
•	Breed brontisauri, t-rexes, and other prehistoric animals
•	Supply your dinosaurs with food, water, and play equipment
•	Equip your dino zoo with snack shacks and souvenir shops for your guests
•	Create a breathtaking dinosaur park experience

Dinosaur Park – Primeval Zoo is one of the most entertaining dinosaur games in the world of apps. The cute prehistoric animals make this tycoon simulation a thrilling hit all dinosaur lovers! If you grew up with the hit movie Jurassic Park and its sequels, this dino game will let you see the prehistoric world with new eyes.

Dinos to Cuddle and Play with

The best part of this dino game? Your dinos react to everything you do! Fill their food troughs and watch them delight in their fodder. Set up play equipment and watch them play with it!

Put your business acumen to the test in this dino zoo game – after all, Dinosaur Park – Primeval Park is also a thrilling tycoon game.

•	Which dinos will attract the most visitors?
•	Where do I best set up my shops for the park guests?
•	How can I most shrewdly invest my profits to keep the registers ringing?
•	When is it worth hiring staff for my dino park?

Which strategies you pursue and how effectively you run your dino zoo game is all up to you! Play Dinosaur Park – Primeval Zoo and experience the most captivating dinosaur game of all time!

Step back in time and explore the prehistoric world with Dino Fun – Dinosaurs!

If you or your budding palaeontologist love dinosaurs, this engaging app is packed with dino games, real facts, and interactive activities that make learning exciting and fun.

Designed by teachers in Canada with over 15 years of childcare experience, Dino Fun follows a learning-through-play approach that keeps children engaged while they discover fascinating facts about dinosaurs that once roamed our planet.

Whether you’re exploring a Dino Park, collecting fossils, or cracking open dino eggs, Dino Fun – Dinosaurs combines education and entertainment in a way kids love.

Dinosaur Bone Collecting Game
Help the palaeontologist collect bones across six exciting dinosaur worlds!  Jump from platform to platform in fast-paced dino games set in fun themes like Jungle, Halloween, and Christmas. When enough bones are collected, they magically come together to form a dinosaur skeleton. Tap the completed skeleton to hear a fun fact about the dinosaur you helped build!  This action-packed Dino Fun game builds coordination, problem-solving, and cognitive skills while keeping kids entertained.

Dinosaur Flashcards
Discover over 30 different dinosaurs with interactive flashcards featuring:
* Real-life images
* Correct pronunciation of dinosaur names
* Fossil visuals
* Over 120 interesting dinosaur facts
Each card includes easy-to-understand icons showing what the dinosaur ate, how big it was, when it lived, where its fossils were found, and one unique fun fact. These Dinosaur Games for Kids are perfect for curious minds who want to learn more about dinosaurs and dinosaurios in an engaging way.

BONUS GAME – Dinosaur Fossil Quiz
Test your knowledge after exploring the flashcards!  Match fossils to the correct dinosaurs by choosing from four options. This quiz is a fun way to reinforce learning and makes Dino Fun even more interactive.

Dino Egg Tapping Game
All dinosaurs hatched from eggs, and now kids can experience the fun of cracking them open! Choose an egg and tap it a certain number of times to make it crack. When it opens, a lively dinosaur animation appears, delighting kids while helping build number recognition and fine motor skills.

Dinosaur Dancing
Tap the dinosaurs and make them dance to fun, upbeat music!
This playful activity is perfect for little fingers that love to tap, tap, tap, and adds another layer of joy to Dino Fun – Dinosaurs.

Why Kids Love Dino Fun
* Multiple dino games in one app
* Real dinosaur facts presented in a kid-friendly way
* Designed by educators
* Encourages curiosity, learning, and imagination
* Perfect for fans of Dino Park, dinosaurs, and dinosaurios

Travel back to prehistoric times and enjoy hours of learning and play with Dino Fun – Dinosaurs! Where Dino Fun, dinosaurs, and education come together for a roaring good time

Jump into a virtual multiplayer world filled with many species of Jurassic era dinos. You can play online and hunt as epic dinosuars like the T-Rex, Spinosaur and Raptor! Can you become the strongest of the pack and survive in this simulator?

Huge 3D Worlds to Explore.

You begin your adventure on the ancient island, and you can progress to an arctic world and even a volcano world!
 
Choose Your Breed

Play as dangerous carnivores like T-Rex, Raptor and the Spinosaur! You can also play as plant-eating herbivoes such as the Triceratops and Iguanadon. Many epic monster dinosaurs to choose from, even babies and rare animals like the Wooly Mammoth and Saber Tooth Tiger!

Hunt Together in Packs

Become the ultimate predator as you team up with your carnivore friends and hunt bigger dinos together. The bigger dinosaur you hunt, the more you can level up your dino! Battle it out and see who is the strongest in the park!

Form Alliances, Meet Friends & Chat

Make friends with other players and chat to plan hunting and survival strategies!

Tons of Missions

Join an adventure to rescue dinosaurs as you hunt, search for food and shelter, and battle for survival.

Updates: Foxie Games are planning lots of stable updates to make the game even more fun.

Play for Free! You can play through the whole game without paying any real money! However, like all our games, Dino World Online is free to play, but it contains upgrades that can be purchased for real money.

Visit our official website at www.foxiegames.com
